title: Optimality of Monotonized Asymptotic Risk
strongest_verified_result: Restricted selection optimality under uniform deterministic approximation; bounded-loss pointwise-convergence counterexample; explicit Gaussian shrinkage limit 11/3 below envelope 4.
remaining_mathematical_gap: A nontrivial statistical optimality principle for an explicitly admissible model and procedure class, with the required uniform lower bound. The source leaves that class unspecified.
known_component: Greatest-nondecreasing-minorant identity and prior one-step improvement are already in the source authors' manuscript.
risk_convention: Conditional full prediction risk, including irreducible noise; convergence in probability. Expected minimax risk is separately defined.
